import openpyxl

      ('JL','jl.new@office.test','jl.service@office.test','jl.review@office.test'),
      ('NP','np.service@office.test','np.service@office.test','np.service@office.test'),
      ('YC','yc.service@office.test','yc.service@office.test','yc.service@office.test'),
      ('QH','qh.service@office.test','qh.service@office.test','qh.service@office.test'),
      ('BA','ba.service@office.test','ba.service@office.test','ba.service@office.test')]
